name: @frontend-playground/multi-ssg-ultimate
description: Ultimate Frontend Playground: Multi-SSG Framework Showcase - The most comprehensive Static Site Generator comparison platform ever built
author: Paul Serban <paul.alex.serban@gmail.com>

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frameworks && npm run install:tools
scripts.install:frameworks: npm run install:js && npm run install:go && npm run install:ruby && npm run install:python && npm run install:php && npm run install:custom
scripts.install:js: npm run install:nextjs && npm run install:nuxtjs && npm run install:sveltekit && npm run install:astro && npm run install:gatsby && npm run install:remix && npm run install:11ty && npm run install:vitepress
scripts.install:go: echo '📦 Go dependencies managed by Hugo binary'
scripts.install:python: npm run install:pelican && npm run install:sphinx && npm run install:custom-python
scripts.install:php: npm run install:jigsaw && npm run install:wp2static
scripts.install:custom: npm run install:handlebars && npm run install:html-templates
scripts.install:tools: cd tools/build-system && npm install || echo 'No package.json in tools'
scripts.install:nextjs: cd frameworks/javascript/nextjs && npm install || echo '⚠️  NextJS not initialized'
scripts.install:nuxtjs: cd frameworks/javascript/nuxtjs && npm install || echo '⚠️  NuxtJS not initialized'
scripts.install:sveltekit: cd frameworks/javascript/sveltekit && npm install || echo '⚠️  SvelteKit not initialized'
scripts.install:astro: cd frameworks/javascript/astro && npm install || echo '⚠️  Astro not initialized'
scripts.install:gatsby: cd frameworks/javascript/gatsby && npm install || echo '⚠️  Gatsby not initialized'
scripts.install:remix: cd frameworks/javascript/remix && npm install || echo '⚠️  Remix not initialized'
scripts.install:11ty: cd frameworks/javascript/11ty && npm install || echo '⚠️  11ty not initialized'
scripts.install:vitepress: cd frameworks/javascript/vitepress && npm install || echo '⚠️  VitePress not initialized'
scripts.install:jekyll: cd frameworks/ruby/jekyll && bundle install || echo '⚠️  Jekyll not initialized'
scripts.install:pelican: cd frameworks/python/pelican && pip install -r requirements.txt || echo '⚠️  Pelican not initialized'
scripts.install:sphinx: cd frameworks/python/sphinx && pip install -r requirements.txt || echo '⚠️  Sphinx not initialized'
scripts.install:custom-python: cd frameworks/custom/python-custom && pip install -r requirements.txt || echo '⚠️  Custom Python not initialized'
scripts.install:jigsaw: cd frameworks/php/jigsaw && composer install || echo '⚠️  Jigsaw not initialized'
scripts.install:wp2static: cd frameworks/php/wp2static && composer install || echo '⚠️  WP2Static not initialized'
scripts.install:handlebars: cd frameworks/custom/handlebars && npm install || echo '⚠️  Custom Handlebars not initialized'
scripts.install:html-templates: cd frameworks/custom/html-templates && npm install || echo '⚠️  Custom HTML Templates not initialized'
scripts.build:js: npm run build:nextjs && npm run build:nuxtjs && npm run build:sveltekit && npm run build:astro && npm run build:gatsby && npm run build:remix && npm run build:11ty && npm run build:vitepress
scripts.build:nextjs: cd frameworks/javascript/nextjs && npm run build || echo '⚠️  NextJS build failed'
scripts.build:nuxtjs: cd frameworks/javascript/nuxtjs && npm run build || echo '⚠️  NuxtJS build failed'
scripts.build:sveltekit: cd frameworks/javascript/sveltekit && npm run build || echo '⚠️  SvelteKit build failed'
scripts.build:astro: cd frameworks/javascript/astro && npm run build || echo '⚠️  Astro build failed'
scripts.build:gatsby: cd frameworks/javascript/gatsby && npm run build || echo '⚠️  Gatsby build failed'
scripts.build:remix: cd frameworks/javascript/remix && npm run build || echo '⚠️  Remix build failed'
scripts.build:11ty: cd frameworks/javascript/11ty && npx @11ty/eleventy || echo '⚠️  11ty build failed'
scripts.build:vitepress: cd frameworks/javascript/vitepress && npm run build || echo '⚠️  VitePress build failed'
scripts.build:hugo: cd frameworks/go/hugo && hugo --minify || echo '⚠️  Hugo build failed'
scripts.build:jekyll: cd frameworks/ruby/jekyll && bundle exec jekyll build || echo '⚠️  Jekyll build failed'
scripts.build:pelican: cd frameworks/python/pelican && pelican content || echo '⚠️  Pelican build failed'
scripts.build:sphinx: cd frameworks/python/sphinx && sphinx-build -b html source build || echo '⚠️  Sphinx build failed'
scripts.build:custom-python: cd frameworks/custom/python-custom && python generator.py || echo '⚠️  Custom Python build failed'
scripts.build:jigsaw: cd frameworks/php/jigsaw && jigsaw build || echo '⚠️  Jigsaw build failed'
scripts.build:wp2static: cd frameworks/php/wp2static && wp wp2static generate || echo '⚠️  WP2Static build failed'
scripts.build:squido: cd frameworks/specialized/squido && npx squido build || echo '⚠️  Squido build failed'
scripts.build:handlebars: cd frameworks/custom/handlebars && node generate.js || echo '⚠️  Custom Handlebars build failed'
scripts.build:html-templates: cd frameworks/custom/html-templates && node build.js || echo '⚠️  Custom HTML Templates build failed'
scripts.dev:jekyll: cd frameworks/ruby/jekyll && bundle exec jekyll serve
scripts.dev:handlebars: cd frameworks/custom/handlebars && npm run dev || node generate.js
scripts.dev:html-templates: cd frameworks/custom/html-templates && npm run dev || node build.js
scripts.dev:dashboard: cd dashboard && npm run dev || node index.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:visual && npm run test:performance && npm run test:accessibility
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:all && npm run deploy:github-pages && npm run deploy:vercel && npm run deploy:netlify
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:builds && npm run clean:node-modules && npm run clean:caches
scripts.start: echo '🚀 Frontend Playground Multi-SSG Platform' && echo 'Available commands:' && npm run
scripts.info: node -e "console.log('📊 Project Info:'); console.log('Node:', process.version); console.log('NPM:', process.env.npm_version); console.log('Platform:', process.platform);"
scripts.health: npm run check:env && npm run test:framework
